source.text: What does the black flag at #SydneySiege stand for? http://t.co/3shTK9yYOh http://t.co/UkVFUgetLd

selection_rule: Kept 30 comments with explicit support or opposition to the source tweet asking/explaining what the black flag at the Sydney siege stood for. Excluded pure links, hostage-safety wishes, jokes, off-topic insults, and comments where the stance toward the flag/Islam/terrorism framing was unclear; balanced 15 support and 15 oppose.
note: support = treats the flag explanation as useful clarification, distinguishes the flag from ISIS or Muslims generally, or rejects broad anti-Islam interpretations; oppose = argues the flag/BBC framing still points to Islam, jihad, or Muslims generally, or criticizes attempts to soften/separate the symbol from Islamist violence.
